sections.text:
This 
 document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be carried 
 out on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the little block.

This pump 
 is used to transfer water from feed water tank to economizer then to high 
 pressure drum.

The first 
 draft initiated by eng. Abdallah Mostafa Saada, revised by eng. Ahmed El-Saaedy, 
 accepted by eng. Khamis Elsherif: maintenance general director and approved by 
 eng. Abd El-Moaty Elrakayby head sector of Mahmoudia Power Station.

This 
 document reviewed by eng. Magdey Mahmoud Hegazy, accepted by eng. Samir Abdel 
 Gilil; MEPC inspection & quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, 
 and certified by eng. Mohamed Nageeb inspection & quality controls head 
 sector.

items: A work permit must be issued.

The maintenance staff should be trained, qualified, and carry the suitable ID 
 safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

The safety department must check the isolation and surrounding the zone of 
 work.

Wear the safety and healthy equipment as safety shoes, safety helmet, 
 breathing mask ... etc
Shutdown the pump.
Disconnect the power supply & rack out the circuit breaker.
Put red tag on the pump.

Close the shutoff valves in the (suction & discharge& balancing &min .flow 
 ).

Let the pumps cool down to about < 80 C measured at the branches, then seal 
 off the cooling water pipes and close all other supply lines.
Loosen all auxiliary lines, such as circulation, cooling liquid, lube oil.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Crane.

Alignment 
 indicators, filler.

Grease gun, Cleaning 
 fluid.

Measure the 
 alignment and record it.

Measure the 
 vibration and record it.

Record the 
 discharge pressure.

Disconnect 
 the motor electrically.

Isolate the 
 pump (Close the isolating valves) and drain it as completely as possible.

Disconnect 
 the auxiliary piping (water cooling).

Uncoupling 
 pump from motor and disconnect any safety devices as well as pressure and 
 temperature measuring instrumentation.

Disconnect 
 pump from suction and discharge piping.

Remove the 
 stud bolts holding pump to base frame using nut and counter-nut and withdraw 
 positioning dowels.

Slide pump 
 on base frame to transfer it to the work shop where it should be rested on two 
 supports.

Pump is to 
 be dismantled from outboard side .

sections.text:
Dismantling 
the 
bearing frame outboard side

items:
Remove 
 protecting guard.

Withdraw 
 deflector outboard side part 98 after loosening its radial set-screws.

Withdraw 
 cover outboard side part 16.

Remove 
 bearing lock nut part 92 and safety washer part S1

Withdraw 
 bearing frame outboard side part 14A with bearings R1 and R2 and spring 
 washers Re.

Remove 
 spacer ring part 116A and inner ring of bearing R2.

Withdraw 
 deflector part 9 after loosing its radial set-screws.

Remove gland 
 part 62.

Remove 
 packing rings.

Remove 
 stuffing box part 83 with closing plate part 305.

Remove shaft 
 sleeve part 60 using tooling.

Withdraw 
 two-piece thrust ring part 132.

Fit 
 balancing disk extracting tool and withdraw balancing disk (part 101).

sections.text:
Dismantling 
the 
bearing Frame inboard 
side

Remove shaft sleeve using special 
tooling ( as indicated for outboard side ).

items:
Dismantle 
 half-coupling pump side.

Withdraw 
 deflector part 9A after loosening radial set-screws.

Remove cover 
 inboard side part 5.

Withdraw 
 bearing lock nut part 92 and safety washer part S1.

Remove 
 bearing frame part 14 with its bearing part R2.

Remove 
 spacer ring part 116.

Withdraw 
 inner ring of bearing part R2.

Remove 
 deflector part 9.

Remove gland 
 part 62 and packing rings.

Remove shaft sleeve using special 
tooling ( as indicated for outboard side ).

With the 
 pump still in horizontal position, slightly loosen nuts ( part 145 ) of 
 tie-rods part 144 in such a way that the casing elements remain assembled.

Put pump 
 casing in vertical position ( with driving shaft and facing downwards ) and 
 rest it on dismantling support frame.

Provide 
 adequate support under shaft.

Loosen and 
 withdraw the nuts on suction side part 145.

Lift 
 discharge collector part 51 with its balancing disk chamber part 100 and the 
 tie-rods part 144 hanging from discharge collector.

Remove end 
 diffuser part 65.

Remove 
 impeller nr 8 part 55 with its key.

Remove 
 inter-stage ring section part 54, them remove nr 7 and inter-stage ring 
 section; repeat this dismantling procedure down to the first diffuser part 64 
 (mounted on suction collector part 52 ).

Fit on shaft 
 part 59 the nut with handling ring and lift shaft with the first impeller part 
 55.

Dismantle 
 impeller.

Clean all 
 parts of the pump.
Change all (O- rings), gaskets and packing.

Change the 
 oil.

All wear 
 parts (Shaft sleeves, impellers, wear rings, balancing disk, balancing disk 
 chamber, bearings) must be checked prior to assembly (Control of clearances) 
 and repaired or replaced if necessary .

Measure the 
 radial clearance for the pump and adjust them.

Inspect the 
 run out of the shaft.

Balancing 
 disk chamber part 100 on discharge collector part 51, not forgetting o-ring 
 T6.

Bearings in 
 bearing frames part 14 and 14A

Wear rings 
 part 68 in suction collector part 52 and in inter-stage ring sections part 54

O-rings T1 
 (previously smeared with tallow) on inter-stage ring sections part 54

Assemble 
 first impeller part 55 on shaft part 59.

Introduce 
 shaft part 59 vertically into suction collector part 52 ( placed horizontally 
 on an adequate support ). Support the shaft in such a way that the impeller 
 does not come loose ( length of protruding shaft segment : 339 mm )

Fit first 
 diffuser part 64 making sure that the insert part 270 is correctly positioned.

Fit first 
 inter-stage ring section pressing it home against collector; the slightest 
 play would falsify the reading of the axial clearance, to be taken when 
 completing assembly.

Fit next 
 impeller and repeat steps described in 7 to 9 up to the last stage.

Mount 
 discharge collector part 51.

Fit the 4 
 tie-rods locking the 2 collectors together and tighten them evenly.

Check total 
 axial clearance.

Fit 
 balancing disk part 100.

Fit 
 two-piece ring part 132.

Slide shaft 
 sleeve part 60 on shaft.

sections.text:
Fit Successively 
the 
following Parts 
( on coupling side )

items:
Shaft sleeve 
 part 61.

Deflector 
 part 9.

Bearing 
 frame part 14 with bearing R2.

Spacer ring 
 part 116.

Bearing lock 
 nut part 92 with safety washers part S1.

Cover part 
 5.

Deflector 
 part 9A

On discharge 
 side, mount stuffing box part 83

Shaft sleeve 
 part 60.

Deflector 
 part 9.

Bearing 
 frame part 14A with bearings and springs washers part Re.

Bearing lock 
 nut part 92 with safety washer part S1.

Cover part 
 16

Fit packing 
 rings and glands.

Put pump 
 back on its base frame.

Connect the 
 various pipe rings.

In the case 
 of oil-lubrication, fit oilers back on bearing frames.

Check pump 
 set alignment.

Tight feet 
 nuts.

Open the 
 suction and delivery of the pump.

Record the 
 alignment.

Record the 
 discharge pressure.

Record the 
 vibration.
